answer: Smuggling 1,000 fakes past the jetty costs the attacker a quorum per fake: every newcomer is inspected by seven established agents drawn by a crystal-clear public lottery, fresh for each identity, so the panel can never be predicted or bribed in advance. A farm must corrupt four of seven strangers for every single fake — hundreds of corrupted agents for a thousand fakes — while each failed inspection burns the fake and flags its backers. Honest agents pass the jetty once, in one epoch, and never queue again; the farm’s glacier of fakes melts at the gate.
